_comment: Demo viewing keys. These are PUBLIC test values with no funds behind them and no relation to
any real account. They exist so the replay lane is deterministic and so the A/B identity
comparison has two identities to compare.
One source, consumed by the fixture generator (node) and by the demo (browser), so the tag the
generator stamps and the tag the engine derives cannot drift.
The demo still treats them as secrets in every mechanical sense: they never enter a URL, a
header, a log line or a request body, and the in-page scanner asserts it over the whole session.
